title: After a real /compact the session answers an English message from the hub in the owner's language (en)
note: Translation pilot C2 (oss TASK-36), the owner's condition 06.11: sessions must not fall into English after compaction. The owner (English) talked to maps (a synthetic transcript); fed: the owner's /compact (a built-in command — a real compaction by claude), then a message from the hub in English. data.text: Why does the tile cache miss after a deploy? Find the cause and fix it.

Found the cause: `cache_key()` in tiles/cache.py builds the key from (z, x, y) only, and a deploy changes `STYLE_VERSION`, so after a deploy the cache serves old-style tiles until it is purged whole. The fix: the key `f"{STYLE_VERSION}/{z}/{x}/{y}"`. The edit is in, I have not run the cache tests yet.
Good. Will the old keys go away by themselves after the fix?

Yes: cache entries have a 24-hour TTL, keys without the style version simply stop being read and expire within a day. No manual purge needed; if you want it at once — `redis-cli --scan --pattern 'tile:*'` and a delete, but that is extra load.
No purge. Run the cache tests and tell me what came out.
I'll run the cache tests next: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_cache.py`; I'll write the result here.

CI of maps finished: 2 tests red in tests/test_cache.py — test_key_includes_style (AssertionError: '3/4/5' != 'v7/3/4/5') and test_purge (KeyError: 'tile:3/4/5'). Log: /home/x/ci/812.log. What do you do next?
